ITEM 1 | Irregular mound of browned, slightly crumbly meat-like mass with reddish-pink interior showing in places and darker seared-brown outer surface, moist-looking with a small amount of dull sheen, about 7 cm by 6 cm footprint and roughly 2 cm tall, sitting in the upper right corner of a large white square plate with some thin bright green herb-like fibers or leaves tucked against its right edge | 110

ITEM 2 | Thin, bright green, stringy herb fragments (a few stems or leaves) lying across the right edge of item 1, matte and slightly wilted, under 4 cm long total | 3
